snippet.title: DeckTerra - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out this new Medieval 4X Deckbuilder game!

Lead a kingdom as you build your deck to conquer the map and expand your rule. Develop your technology through the middle ages to improve your army of knights and keep your peasants happy. Develop your trade, religion, science, and military to conquer the continent. 

Wishlist DeckTerra on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3760980/DeckTerra/
